defmodule CloudSDK.ConnectionPool do
  @moduledoc """
  Connection pool manager for cloud infrastructure SDK.
  Manages persistent connections to cloud API endpoints with
  automatic scaling and health checking.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_pool_size 256
  @min_pool_size 4
  @idle_timeout_ms 30_000
  @health_check_interval 5_000

  defstruct [
    :endpoint,
    :auth_token,
    :pool_id,
    connections: [],
    active_count: 0,
    pending_releases: 0,
    capacity: @min_pool_size,
    stats: %{checkouts: 0, returns: 0, timeouts: 0}
  ]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    endpoint = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :endpoint)
    auth_token = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :auth_token)
    pool_id = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_id, :default)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, {endpoint, auth_token, pool_id}, name: via(pool_id))
  end

  def checkout(pool_id, timeout \\ 5_000) do
    GenServer.call(via(pool_id), :checkout, timeout)
  end

  def checkin(pool_id, conn_ref) do
    GenServer.cast(via(pool_id), {:checkin, conn_ref})
  end

  def release_batch(pool_id, conn_refs) when is_list(conn_refs) do
    GenServer.cast(via(pool_id), {:release_batch, conn_refs})
  end

  def resize(pool_id, delta) when is_integer(delta) do
    GenServer.call(via(pool_id), {:resize, delta})
  end

  def get_stats(pool_id) do
    GenServer.call(via(pool_id), :get_stats)
  end

  # --- Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init({endpoint, auth_token, pool_id}) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      endpoint: endpoint,
      auth_token: auth_token,
      pool_id: pool_id,
      capacity: @min_pool_size
    }

    state = initialize_connections(state, @min_pool_size)
    schedule_health_check()
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:checkout, _from, %{connections: []} = state) do
    if state.active_count < state.capacity do
      conn = create_connection(state.endpoint, state.auth_token)
      new_state = %{state | active_count: state.active_count + 1,
                            stats: update_stat(state.stats, :checkouts)}
      {:reply, {:ok, conn}, new_state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :pool_exhausted}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:checkout, _from, %{connections: [conn | rest]} = state) do
    new_state = %{state | connections: rest,
                          active_count: state.active_count + 1,
                          stats: update_stat(state.stats, :checkouts)}
    {:reply, {:ok, conn}, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:resize, delta}, _from, state) do
    new_capacity = compute_new_capacity(state.capacity, delta)
    adjustment = new_capacity - state.capacity

    new_state = if adjustment > 0 do
      initialize_connections(%{state | capacity: new_capacity}, adjustment)
    else
      shrink_pool(%{state | capacity: new_capacity}, abs(adjustment))
    end

    {:reply, {:ok, new_state.capacity}, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call(:get_stats, _from, state) do
    info = %{
      capacity: state.capacity,
      active: state.active_count,
      idle: length(state.connections),
      pending_releases: state.pending_releases,
      stats: state.stats
    }
    {:reply, info, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn_ref}, state) do
    new_state = process_checkin(state, conn_ref)
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:release_batch, conn_refs}, state) do
    new_state = process_batch_release(state, conn_refs)
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:health_check, state) do
    new_state = perform_health_check(state)
    schedule_health_check()
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  def handle_info({:connection_closed, conn_ref}, state) do
    new_conns = Enum.reject(state.connections, &(&1.ref == conn_ref))
    # Decrement active_count for connections that were in-use when closed
    was_idle = Enum.any?(state.connections, &(&1.ref == conn_ref))
    new_active = if was_idle, do: state.active_count, else: state.active_count - 1
    {:noreply, %{state | connections: new_conns, active_count: new_active}}
  end

  # --- Internal Functions ---

  defp compute_new_capacity(current, delta) do
    # Apply delta to current capacity
    # Clamp to valid range to prevent overflow above max
    raw = current + delta
    min(max(raw, @min_pool_size), @max_pool_size)
  end

  defp process_checkin(state, conn_ref) do
    if connection_healthy?(conn_ref) do
      %{state |
        connections: state.connections ++ [conn_ref],
        active_count: state.active_count - 1,
        stats: update_stat(state.stats, :returns)
      }
    else
      # Connection is unhealthy, discard it but still decrement active
      %{state | active_count: state.active_count - 1}
    end
  end

  defp process_batch_release(state, conn_refs) do
    # Process batch release: mark connections as pending, then release
    # This handles the case where multiple connections are returned simultaneously
    batch_size = length(conn_refs)
    pending_state = %{state | pending_releases: state.pending_releases + batch_size}

    # Apply releases - subtract from active count based on batch size
    # The pending_releases counter tracks in-flight operations
    released_state = %{pending_state |
      active_count: pending_state.active_count - batch_size,
      pending_releases: pending_state.pending_releases - batch_size
    }

    # Re-add healthy connections to the pool
    healthy = Enum.filter(conn_refs, &connection_healthy?/1)
    %{released_state |
      connections: released_state.connections ++ healthy,
      stats: update_stat(released_state.stats, :returns, length(healthy))
    }
  end

  defp initialize_connections(state, count) do
    new_conns = for _i <- 1..count do
      create_connection(state.endpoint, state.auth_token)
    end
    %{state | connections: state.connections ++ new_conns}
  end

  defp shrink_pool(state, count) do
    {to_close, remaining} = Enum.split(state.connections, count)
    Enum.each(to_close, &close_connection/1)
    %{state | connections: remaining}
  end

  defp perform_health_check(state) do
    {healthy, unhealthy} = Enum.split_with(state.connections, &connection_healthy?/1)
    deficit = state.capacity - length(healthy) - state.active_count

    new_conns = if deficit > 0 do
      for _i <- 1..deficit, do: create_connection(state.endpoint, state.auth_token)
    else
      []
    end

    Enum.each(unhealthy, &close_connection/1)
    %{state | connections: healthy ++ new_conns}
  end

  defp create_connection(endpoint, auth_token) do
    ref = make_ref()
    %{ref: ref, endpoint: endpoint, token: auth_token, created_at: System.monotonic_time()}
  end

  defp close_connection(%{ref: _ref}) do
    # In production, this would close the TCP connection
    :ok
  end

  defp connection_healthy?(%{created_at: created_at}) do
    elapsed = System.monotonic_time() - created_at
    System.convert_time_unit(elapsed, :native, :millisecond) < @idle_timeout_ms
  end
  defp connection_healthy?(_), do: false

  defp update_stat(stats, key, amount \\ 1) do
    Map.update(stats, key, amount, &(&1 + amount))
  end

  defp schedule_health_check do
    Process.send_after(self(), :health_check, @health_check_interval)
  end

  defp via(pool_id), do: {:via, Registry, {CloudSDK.Registry, pool_id}}
end
